description: Rendering markup supplied by the parent inside a child component, via `<ng-content>`.
A named slot matching top-level children by CSS selector, e.g. `select="[card-title]"`.
The `<ng-content>` without `select`; receives content matching no other slot.
Content inside `<ng-content>...</ng-content>` shown when nothing is projected into that slot (Angular 18+).
Makes an element (often `<ng-container>`) match a slot selector it doesn't naturally match.
